how_generated: 240 tokens; the 16-candidate tournament runs at a randomly chosen 42% of positions and the remaining positions are drawn uniformly (random.Random(seed=3102)). Models text that is only partly machine generated, which is what lands the mean-g between the thresholds.
why_it_matters: Same mechanism at ordinary length. Sits near the middle of the uncertain band, so it stays uncertain even if either threshold moves by 0.03.
